finding: IT-Software / Software Services has the largest listing share
recommendation: Use industry concentration as a starting point for exploration, not as a guarantee of vacancies.
feasibility: High; use the industry and role filters in the dashboard.
expected_impact: Helps prioritize further research and skill planning.
limitation: One portal sample; industry classification and sampling bias may distort representation.

finding: Bengaluru is the most frequent primary city
evidence: 7,936 listings (36.9% of listings with a primary city)
recommendation: Compare city-level listing volume with cost of living and current live opportunities before relocating.
feasibility: Medium; requires external current information not present in this dataset.
limitation: First listed city is treated as primary; multi-city postings are simplified.

finding: Software Development is the largest identifiable role family
recommendation: Review the role taxonomy manually and align training suggestions with validated role-specific skills.
feasibility: Medium; requires human review of ambiguous titles.

recommendation: Use Communication, SQL, Java as candidate topics for curriculum review, then validate against current postings and employer input.
limitation: Keyword mentions are not confirmed mandatory skills; fixed vocabulary may miss terms.

evidence: 14.9% of all listings have comparable numeric salary values.
recommendation: Consider publishing transparent, standardized pay ranges.
feasibility: High operationally, subject to employer policy.
expected_impact: May improve candidate clarity and reduce unnecessary application mismatch.
limitation: The dataset cannot establish that disclosure causes better recruitment outcomes.

finding: Most common parsed minimum experience band: 3-5 yrs minimum
recommendation: Provide differentiated learning pathways for entry-level and experienced candidates.
feasibility: Medium; depends on course and employer partnerships.
expected_impact: Better alignment of training with observed listing requirements.
limitation: Parsed minimum experience groups simplify source ranges.
